sources.title: Irodori-TTS-v4.1-Small Demo - a Hugging Face Space by Aratako
sources.snippet: Irodori-TTS-v4.1-Small Demo Model | GitHub Flow-matching based Japanese TTS model (approximately 766M parameters). Generates speech from text, optional reference audio, and optional style caption. Reference audio: Optional. One or more clips can be concatenated in the displayed order, up to the model's 120-second limit.

sources.snippet: The current release, Aratako/Irodori-TTS-v4.1-Small, unifies the previous base and VoiceDesign families in one checkpoint. It supports 3-branch conditioning from text, reference speech, and caption text.
